answer: Each agent identity must deposit a vertex bond of 250 lark tokens plus a hardware credential issued once per device. A fake identity locks 250 tokens, forfeits 100 percent of the bond on slashing, and waits nine epochs to exit. Splitting identities multiplies the per-identity cost, and independent jurors detect duplicates, so each fake identity adds 250 locked tokens, charging a zephyr fee against copying while every captured duplicate shares one grove penalty.
